explanation: The Almighty Creator who is the foundation of all laws concerning care and justice in the church.
Honorable recognition given to older men, women, or God through respectful behavior and proper treatment.
People of advanced age who should be treated with the same reverence one gives to their own parents.
A spouse who has lost their husband; in this chapter, a distinction is made between true widows without family and those who can receive help from relatives.
The duty to look after family members, especially the elderly or lonely, before the church intervenes with support.
Prayers for all people, including kings and leaders, as well as thanksgiving for God's grace in daily life.
Instruction about a faithful life that should be passed on to younger women through older female mentors.
Actions that violate God's will; the chapter warns against judging a priest without evidence and assumes that sinners are corrected by two witnesses.
